title: Quality Machine With Instruction Manual Issues. Plastic Taste
text:
Quality Machine With Instruction Manual Issues. Plastic Taste. I am impressed with most aspects of this product.

Pros:
Appears to be well made and well put together
Fairly small footprint for an office or studio space. Pretty self contained.
Can be connected by non plumbing personnel but having some experience helps.
Hot water in a flash
Great tasting cold water no bottles involved.
So far no leaking issues.

Cons:
Basically the instructions are kind of goofy. Missing steps and things not mentioned. The pictures could definitely be a little bigger and show all the steps involved, not just some of them. There seem to be some steps missing and I can see people having problems with connections and things not working because of it.

There needs to be more complete information about the features of the machine and what to expect when you turn it on etc. My self cleaning light is on and I can't figure out if it should be or not. Nothing on the website or the manual. Really incomplete.

It would be nice if there was some way to tidy up the connections and tubing that hangs all over the back of this.

This bills itself as a "countertop" model, but there are no instructions for how you would make this work on a counter as far as making the connections, etc. If I wanted to use this in say a kitchen, I would imagine you would have to drill a hole through the counter for the water line. That would not be nice if you have granite counters.

This will work quite well in my art studio, providing me with good drinking water no bottles involved, and the ability to make hot drinks as well.

UPDATE: Changing my review to 3 stars instead of 4. After using this for several days and following all the instructions, the cold water from this tastes like plastic unless you waste a bunch running it out. According to the instructions you should run a quart of water through in the beginning. I did this. But every morning after the machine has set overnight the first bit tastes like plastic. I have a well, so my water tastes great to start with.

product_metadata.title: Avalon A8CTBOTTLELESSBLK Hot & Cold Water, NSF Certified Filter, UL/Energy Star, Black
features: HOT & COLD WATER SPOUTS: When you use our water cooler dispenser you can choose between a Crisp Cold & Piping Hot Output, making it ideal for cool refreshments or toasty beverages.

CHILD SAFE: Our water cooler dispenser is UL/Energy Star Approved and features a child safety lock on the hot water spout so the entire family can use it worry free! Your children will not accidentally burn themselves!
SELF CLEANING FEATURE: The self cleaning ozone feature sanitizes & purifies the dispenser, which prevents the accumulation of harmful germs & bacteria for your safety.
LIGHT THE WAY: Our built-in nightlight makes the water spouts clearly visible at night & has a replace filter indicator that lights up when the filter needs to be replaced. Heating Capacity: 4 L/H

BOTTLELESS: Our water cooler is bottleless and will reduce the cost of constant purchases of water and will eliminate the strain of lifting bottles and will eliminate unwanted spills. Included is one 6 month/1500 gallon sediment filter and one 6 month/1500 gallon carbon block filter.
Note: Kindly refer user manual provided before use for installation.
Included in the Box:Avalon A8 Bottleless countertop Water Cooler,1 Sediment Filter,1 Activated Carbon Block Filter,Installation Kit - No Technician Required,Use and Care Guide
description: The Avalon Countertop Hot/Cold Water Cooler is made with innovation and style. The easy-to-use paddle spouts make it so much more convenient to use. Simply press your cup against the paddle to let the flow of water to come out. The machines highly efficient compressor makes the cold water crisp and ice cold at approximately 47° F without the need of adding ice cubes to your drink. The hot faucet is hot enough to cook one's tea or coffee or any other steaming hot beverage at approximately 185° F. Due to the extremely hot water, we’ve added a child safety lock on the hot water faucet. There is a built-in nightlight making the water spouts clearly visible in the dark. This water cooler is bottle-less with an NSF certified activated carbon filter (listed as model Avalon A4FILTER) and a sediment filter (listed as model Avalon A5FILTER) with a water line that can be attached to your water source. The water is taken from your water source and filtered through the filters and then through the machines hot and cold water tanks. The filter will purify the tap water eliminating any chlorine, and lead. There is also a built-in leak detector to automatically monitor the water flow from the water source into the machine. We have incorporated a self-clean function which will automatically clean the machine’s water tank with the press of a switch. The dispensing area is 10x2.5x9.5 inches with 7.5 inches of space below the spouts. The water cooler is UL listed and complies with all standards of Energy Star. Setup is easy and the unit can be connected directly to your existing sink water line. All parts necessary for installation are included. The unit dimensions are 12x12x19 inches.
